name: Kill Part
description: Turn any part into a deadly obstacle that instantly eliminates players on contact.
details: A simple kill brick system that detects when a player touches a part and instantly eliminates their character.

scripts.name: KillPart.server.lua
scripts.description: Detects player contact and eliminates their character.

instructions: In Roblox Studio, select the Part you want to turn into a kill brick.
Insert a normal Script inside the Part.
Copy the contents of the Kill Part script into your new Script.
Press Play to test the system. Players will now be eliminated when they touch the part.
notes: This example instantly eliminates characters using their Humanoid.

explanation.title: Understanding the Kill Part
explanation.intro: Walk through how a part detects contact, finds the character's Humanoid, and reduces its health to zero.

sections.title: Getting the part this script controls
sections.description: script.Parent refers to the object the Script is inside. Put this server Script directly inside the Part you want to use as the kill obstacle.
sections.note: Because the Script is inside the part, the same code can work with any part you place it in.

sections.title: Listening for contact
sections.description: Touched fires when another physical object touches the part. Connect attaches a callback function so the script can inspect the object that made contact.
sections.note: A character is made from several body parts, so the touching object is often a limb rather than the character model itself.

sections.title: Finding a character's Humanoid
sections.description: hit.Parent is treated as the character model. FindFirstChildOfClass looks for an object whose class is Humanoid, which controls a character's health and movement.
sections.note: Objects without a Humanoid will not be eliminated by the next check.

sections.title: Eliminating the character
sections.description: The if statement checks that a Humanoid was found before changing it. Setting Health to zero eliminates that character. The final end statements close the condition and the touch callback.
sections.code:
if humanoid then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)
sections.note: This example responds to any touching object that belongs to a model with a Humanoid.
